meta.title: Brand Teams | Cluega
meta.description: Enterprise brand teams use Cluega to break down the data silos between ads, conversations and orders, building a dedicated AI revenue-growth hub — no matter which model runs underneath, the context always belongs to you.

hero.title: Give your brand a marketing brain that truly belongs to you
hero.subtitle: Enterprise brand teams use Cluega to break down the data silos between ads, conversations and orders, building a dedicated AI revenue-growth hub — no matter which model runs underneath, the context always belongs to you.

items.title: Give data a real “business context”
items.body: Every metric, creative, dialogue and decision converges here. This isn’t just stacking tools — it’s a full-stack operating foundation built for your team, where every call runs on top of your brand’s context.

items.title: Real API data, no AI hallucinations
items.body: Every diagnosis, analysis and decision basis the system produces is synced 100% in real time from the social-platform APIs you connect, your store order flow and real historical performance — optimization is no longer guesswork.

items.title: Shoulder to shoulder with industry leaders
items.body: Sub-50ms response latency, 99.98% always-on uptime, physical multi-tenant data isolation, and local compliance including PDPL — enterprise-grade architecture, ready out of the box.

lifecycle.title: One platform, carrying your brand’s full-lifecycle assets

tabs.subtitle: Embed your brand into the system’s core
tabs.body: Embed your brand’s tone of voice, core product details and sales methodology into the system’s core. Ensure AI’s output and replies never drift from your positioning — no matter which large model everyone calls underneath.

tabs.subtitle: Turn IM leads straight into precise audiences
tabs.body: Close the traffic loop perfectly. The precise leads accumulated in IM can be packaged into a custom Audience with one click, and applied directly to precise ad targeting afterwards — a complete brand data flywheel.

tabs.subtitle: See real conversions right inside your ad account
tabs.body: Inside Cluega’s ad accounts you can directly see how MMT and CRM conversion counts link to front-end ads, and even know the real conversion cost — attribution is no longer broken.

tabs.subtitle: Security isn’t an add-on, it’s the default
tabs.body: Physical multi-tenant data isolation (ClickHouse-grade), fine-grained permissions (RBAC / IAM), OAuth authorization and local data compliance (including PDPL) — security by design runs through every single model call.

built.title: Built for brand teams
built.overview: Cluega lets brands bring scattered data, creative and conversations back into one brand brain, and makes every dollar of spend traceable to real revenue.

cards.title: Automatic brand-tone alignment
cards.body: Upload enterprise documents and they’re read and deeply understood automatically, ensuring every line of copy and every visual generated matches your brand settings precisely.

cards.title: Cross-model context continuity
cards.body: It records the full evolution of assets and copy; when switching between different models across departments, AI still picks up exactly where the context left off.

cards.title: Pay for real results
cards.body: Say goodbye to expensive, unpredictable token billing — pay only for states like “qualified leads” and “orders,” from $0.99 each.

quote.text: We help clients bridge the data silos between ads and orders, surfacing real attribution and performance in real time, which dramatically lifts delivery efficiency and drives revenue growth.
quote.name: Marcus Vance
